messages.text: Looked up for Sarah: Magic Miner 40T is $799, Batch 6 pre-sale, ships November 21 2026 — our best value per terahash; date depends on the manufacturer.

Hey, I'm Sarah! At about sixteen cents the Magic Miner 40T costs around $75 a month to run. It's $799, and it draws for a full block every ten minutes. Would it run on a desk, or somewhere out of the way? Tap an answer, or the mic and tell me.
Looked up for Sarah: 40T is tunable: 30 TH/s at 450W, 40 at 650W, 50 at 850W turbo — so he can dial power to fit the setup he already runs.
Nice. The 40T gives you forty terahash for seven ninety-nine, about twenty dollars a terahash, our best value. Will you point it solo or at a pool? (The call ended. 1 shopper turn(s). Reply NOTHING.)
